rubrics.justification: The model explicitly stated no image was available and avoided fabricating embryo morphology, which is appropriate and avoids inaccurate claims.
It integrated age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, cycle history, and semen data well with prognosis, though embryo-specific interaction was limited by the missing image.
The reasoning is logical, internally consistent, and appropriately caveated; the implantation range follows from the favorable clinical profile and absent morphology data.
Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET preference in a good-prognosis 33-year-old and cautious use of PGT-A, with only minor generalizations.
It provides practical next steps for transfer management and future cycle review, though some advice remains general because embryo morphology and lab details were unavailable.
